answer: Attackers forging many identities must fund every one, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts while rewards stay capped. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bonded stake tied to a verifiable reputation thread before voting or earning. Honest agents build standing on a shared mesa of verified history, and any identity stepping onto the reputation ledge without that backing is throttled, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
